recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-11698 unless CDS later changes PlanDefinition.action.code semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-11698 asked that the old PlanDefinition.actionDefinition.concept description be changed from merely describing the meaning of an action or sub-actions to wording that semantically reflects a code or CodeableConcept representing the action or sub-actions. The Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution clarified that the renamed code element was not limited to a direct action code and could carry a LOINC code for a documentation-template section.
initial_application: The Jira comments point to SVN 10991, which maps to git commit 21f9927fb4fedda589d3b327259b2400f4f652a0. That commit changed the then-authoritative PlanDefinition spreadsheet source and the parallel RequestGroup action-code source to the expanded wording. Later QA and source-layout commits corrected the article typo and carried the wording into current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: PlanDefinition and RequestOrchestration are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current PlanDefinition.action.code now says the code provides meaning, grouping, or classification and includes the LOINC documentation-template example; the later same-element FHIR-27039 refinement is already audited separately on the combined branch. RequestOrchestration.action.code still carries the original FHIR-11698-style wording inherited from RequestGroup.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the active PlanDefinition source already satisfies the seed issue when the original application and later FHIR-27039 refinement are considered together.
